scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1; analytic sequence statements only; identifying a sequence with a waiting-time tail needs the separate probabilistic tail-sum bridge.
statement: The real sequence 1/(n+1) tends to zero while its finite partial sums tend to infinity; a normalized nonnegative survival sequence with a strictly positive uniform lower stopping hazard delta has every truncated sum bounded by 1/delta.
